message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. The case: defendant forged state agency documents and seals. Specifically, forged "中华人民共和国机动车驾驶员培训记录" and used private seal "驾校培训记录审核专用章". This is forging state agency documents/official seals. The charge is "伪造国家机关印章罪" (forging state organ seals) or "伪造国家机关证件、印章罪". In Chinese criminal law, there is "伪造国家机关印章罪" (Article 280) and "伪造国家机关证件、印章罪". The summary earlier: For first example, they gave answer "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章、印章". Actually they gave "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". That seems a combined label. In the prior examples, they gave answer "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". So we should use that exact label.

Thus only one charge: 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章
